question: Which Linux companion app implementation direction should OpenClaw sponsor for this umbrella issue now that Windows Hub is shipped?
rationale: The remaining work is a broad native-app product and security decision with competing open Linux PRs, so automation should not choose the permanent architecture or package boundary.

options.title: Choose one Linux track
options.body: Pick the GTK/C or Rust/GTK direction, review it against the app/security boundary, and close or park the competing track.

options.title: Split into smaller platform milestones
options.body: Keep this issue as an umbrella and open narrower Linux distribution, pairing, tray, chat, and permissions milestones before landing app code.

options.title: Defer Linux companion apps
options.body: Leave the issue open but explicitly defer native Linux app work until current security and setup priorities are complete.

recommendation.title: Choose one Linux track
recommendation.body: Pick the GTK/C or Rust/GTK direction, review it against the app/security boundary, and close or park the competing track.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue body and follow-up comments set the product direction, and the app/platform history also points to steipete for the final scope call.
